faqs.question: What Topics Are Covered in PMP Training?
faqs.answer: Our PMP Training covers all key areas including Project Initiation, Planning, Execution, Monitoring & Control, and Closure. You will also learn Knowledge Areas like Integration, Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality, Risk, and Stakeholder Management. For full details, please check our course brochure.

faqs.question: What Is the Course Schedule?
faqs.answer: Training sessions are conducted on weekends, with 4-hour live classes each day (Saturday & Sunday, 9:30 AM – 1:30 PM IST). This format ensures flexibility and focus for working professionals.

faqs.question: Are Weekday Batches Available?
faqs.answer: Currently, we only offer weekend batches. All live sessions are conducted on Saturdays and Sundays to maintain quality and learning continuity.

faqs.question: Do You Offer Self-Paced Learning?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide recorded sessions for self-paced learners. Please note that real-time doubt clarification is not included in this mode.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Exam Application Assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes! We guide you through the PMP application process step by step — from eligibility checks to PMI registration and scheduling your exam.

faqs.question: Can I Download the Training Videos?
faqs.answer: No, downloads are not available. However, you will have secure access to all recordings and materials through our LMS for 1 year.

faqs.question: Can I Enroll in a Single Module Instead of the Full Course?
faqs.answer: No, PMP Training is delivered as a complete certification preparation course covering all domains and process groups together.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Resume and Profile Guidance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide professional resume-building and LinkedIn optimization support to help you showcase your PMP credentials effectively.

faqs.question: Is a Laptop or Desktop Required for the Training?
faqs.answer: Yes, a laptop or desktop is required to access the LMS, attend online classes, and practice with case studies and mock exams.

faqs.question: Are There Any Prerequisites for This Training?
faqs.answer: This course is designed for professionals with experience in managing projects or teams. Prior project management knowledge is helpful but not required, as the program bridges real-world experience with PMP principles.

faqs.question: Do You Teach from the Basics?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We start from project management fundamentals and progress step-by-step to advanced PMP concepts as per PMI standards.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Placement Assistance?
faqs.answer: No, PMP is a certification-oriented course. However, we offer guidance to help you apply PMP principles in your current or future job roles effectively.

faqs.question: Do You Provide PMP Certification Support?
faqs.answer: Yes, we support your PMP certification journey by sharing sample questions, study guides, and exam preparation strategies.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Study Materials and Notes?
faqs.answer: Yes, all learners receive soft copies of study materials, class notes, and additional resources prepared by our certified PMP trainer.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Mock Exams and Practice Questions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer module-wise mock tests and practice exams to help you evaluate your readiness for the actual PMP exam.

faqs.question: Do You Provide LMS Access for Learning?
faqs.answer: Yes, all learners get 1-year access to our LMS, which includes session recordings, materials, and progress tracking.

faqs.question: Can I Retake the Course?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can attend multiple upcoming PMP batches within 1 year at no additional cost under your active membership.

faqs.question: Will I Get a Course Completion Certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes, after completing the training successfully, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate with 35 PDUs required for PMP exam eligibility.

faqs.question: Is Coding or Technical Knowledge Required?
faqs.answer: No, PMP focuses on project management principles, people, and processes. It does not require any coding or programming knowledge.

faqs.question: Is One-on-One Training Available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer personalized one-on-one sessions on request. Please note that the pricing for individual training differs from group batches.
